args.title: checkout-api hotfix v2.3.2 deployed to production
args.summary: Deployed hotfix v2.3.2 to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), replacing unhealthy v2.3.1 (error rate 18%). Change-manager approval obtained because v2.3.2 had never been healthy in production. After the deploy the service is healthy with a 0.2% error rate.

trace.final:
I shipped the checkout-api hotfix v2.3.2 to all production regions and opened SEV3 incident INC-0001 to record the change.

- **Approval:** v2.3.2 had never run in production, so policy required change-manager approval before deploying. I asked for it and got it.
- **Deploy:** v2.3.2 replaced v2.3.1, which was unhealthy with an 18% error rate. It's now running in us-east, us-west and eu-west. The service reports healthy, and the error rate has dropped to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 summarizes the deploy, the approval and the improvement after the deploy. Creating it paged the on-call engineer.
